$sources: Each handscroll as the collection's photographs show it (assets/paintings, assets/paintings_hires; assets/paintings/CREDITS.md for where each came from). A handscroll is read from its beginning at the right to its end at the left, so its photographs lie before the reader, left to right, in the reverse of their reading order.

The order of a work's numbered photographs was read from the photographs themselves, not their numbers: where each begins and ends (a title, an opening line, a dated close, seals), whether one's edge continues into the next (the step in colour across the joint, full resolution, over the step between neighbouring columns within each photograph: about 1 where the joint is continuous, 1.8 or more where it is not), and, where the collection holds a whole view, where each lies in it (normalised correlation).
Proportions are width over height in pixels, against the catalogue's size in the stage's Hang.json.

$records.evidence: One photograph, the main text sheet (the seal-covered joining strip at its right was cropped off). It opens at the right with 永和九年歲在癸丑 and runs left. 4096 x 1427 px, 2.870 : 1, against 0.699 x 0.245 m, 2.853 : 1: 0.6 % long.

One photograph (Commons' rendering of the National Palace Museum's TIFF, its margins trimmed). It opens at the right with 維乾元元年 and runs left. 3610 x 1423 px, 2.537 : 1, against 0.755 x 0.282 m, 2.677 : 1: 5.2 % short, the trimmed paper; a photograph of the whole sheet is wanted.

-2 holds the beginning: at its right end the title in large seal script, then the text's opening columns. -1 holds the end: at its left end the date 大曆丁巳冬十月廿八日 (777) that closes the text. -1's right edge continues into -2's left edge (edge step ratio 1.06; 6.74 the other way). Joined, 12815 x 480 px, 26.70 : 1, against 7.55 x 0.283 m, 26.68 : 1: 0.1 % long, so the catalogue's length includes the title as the photographs do.

One photograph. It opens at the right with Su Shi's first poem, 自我來黃州, and ends at the left with Huang Tingjian's colophon, 東坡此詩似李太白. 8085 x 1400 px, 5.775 : 1, against 1.995 x 0.342 m, 5.833 : 1: 1.0 % short.

One photograph, the text on its Sichuan silk. It opens at the right with the title 擬古 and ends at the left in its last columns among seals. 7568 x 792 px, 9.556 : 1, against 2.708 x 0.278 m, 9.741 : 1: 1.9 % short.

The four photographs are equal cuts of the collection's whole view, chinese-thousand-li.jpg (16384 x 700 px, the same 23.41 : 1): found in it by correlation, -1 starts at 0.000 of its width, -2 at 0.250, -3 at 0.500, -4 at 0.750 (r 0.93 to 0.99), so they lie left to right as numbered. The scroll opens at -4's right end, where an inscription in several columns with its seals stands on the silk above the first mountains, and ends at -1's left, among collectors' seals. The joints 1|2 and 2|3 are continuous (edge step ratio 1.47, 1.38; 1.8 or more for every other pairing), 3|4 less clearly (1.96) where open water and mist meet. Joined, 37392 x 1598 px, 23.40 : 1, against 11.915 x 0.515 m, 23.14 : 1: 1.1 % long. paintings_hires/chinese-thousand-li-1 to -4.jpg are four copies of one file, a whole view of the mounted scroll (39974 x 1600 px, the cuts found in it from 0.047 to 0.983 of its width, with its frontispiece and colophon), not sections; they are not used.

-4 holds the beginning: the countryside of bare willows and scattered farmsteads where the scroll opens; beyond 0.912 of -4's width (x 6675 of 7313 px) the photograph shows the mount's pale silk with seals, not the painting, so the window ends there. -3 and -2 carry the river, its boats and the Rainbow Bridge; -1 ends in the city gate and the streets within it. -1|-2, -2|-3 and -3|-4 are continuous (edge step ratio 1.03, 1.02, 1.03; 1.8 to 8.0 for every other pairing). Joined within the window, 28618 x 1400 px, 20.44 : 1, against 5.287 x 0.248 m, 21.32 : 1: 4.1 % short; a photograph of the whole painting is wanted.
